name: 担当者・案件・分類・重複などの自動提案方針の一覧
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized product UI screenshot of the six-row proposal-settings list shown in the supplied source crop. Keep it a compact standalone list with no page header.

Use six equal-height white rows with very light horizontal dividers and a subtle rounded outer border. Each row has a pale-gray rounded-square icon tile at the far left, a dark-gray Japanese label, then a white outlined pill dropdown labeled 「表示」 with a small outlined view glyph and down chevron. Match the airy, restrained Linear-like styling and align all rows consistently.

Use exactly these rows from top to bottom, with a distinct simple line icon in each tile: 1) people icon, 「担当者の提案」; 2) project/cube icon, 「案件の提案」; 3) tag icon, 「分類の提案」; 4) team/profile-card icon, 「チームの提案」; 5) overlapping-squares icon, 「重複する課題の提案」; 6) related-issue icon, 「関連する課題の提案」.

Rows 1 through 4 each have an additional separate circular outlined filter-lines button at the far right after the dropdown. Rows 5 and 6 have only the dropdown and no filter button; preserve this difference exactly. Do not add switches, checkboxes, helper copy, menu overlays, or other controls.

Use the original crop for control order, icons, row spacing, divider weight, and sizing. Use the Japanese mock for exact localized wording and its compact typography. Use Meiryo Regular 14/24 for labels and actions. Fit all six rows into a 1.66:1 frame with no extra margins or blank bands. Crisp Japanese glyphs, no English text.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at 1615x974 (1.658:1), matching the 814x491 source crop (1.658:1). All six localized rows and icons are present in order; rows 1–4 have the filter control, while rows 5–6 correctly omit it. Exact font metrics and pixel-level icon alignment remain unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
